value.rationale: Clipping and curvature adaptation are Sophia's defining design choices, and the source emphasizes condition-number-independent behavior. The result identifies the exact scalar control ratio behind that behavior in the clean diagonal setting. It gives a sharp global convergence boundary, an explicit failure cycle, an exact burn-in time, and a finite-time resonance that annihilates all coordinates independently of curvature. These facts directly clarify how the learning-rate and clipping/Hessian-scale hyperparameters interact.
